reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual content review covers849-line COVERAGE.json, all root fields, fiveT1–T5paths, all37file records with complete paths/hashes/filelength/readranges/readers/semanticcounts/reviewqualifiers, three reader-repair records, six exclusions and four aggregate counts. Every record was actually read via compact lossless JSON serialization in three bounded row groups, not path/count metadata alone. Per-file inclusive range unions equal each declared semantic_lines, and sum3112; this is receipt arithmetic, not a new reading of3112external source lines. Preserve exact raw JSON bytes/schema and original archive SHAe88084a4da4dc2ef1576f01b721ee57ab7643f4e7324072fe887c9c45bde0871.

F2: Selected source complete means these five traced paths/37spans, including declarations/helpers/comments, not whole files, all talents/egos/campaign/DLC or gameplay. Engine package and game package are distinct from the C RNGbinding. Reader material-anchor repair/review is not every primary rereading every listed line. Acquisition/hash/readback statements are historical; no current download/version/license/source-file hash validation occurs. Missing RNG/replay lifecycle, all hook variants, serialization/profile durability, balance distributions and art/media remain explicit. Review of this map adds no external-source reading credit.

F3: T1ordinary training prerequisites/points/cap versus force-teach, raw rank versus effective mastery and actual function remain separate. T2eligibility/actionpayment/cooldown/attemptedhit/resistedstatus, reserved stamina capacity versus spent upkeep, effect lifetime/cleanup versus prior damage differ. T3authored NPCkit/legal candidates/current tactical wants/failed-candidate retry/fallback do not establish optimal policy or measured action frequency. T4escort success/failure/attributed betrayal, individual method versus category unlock, actor partial progress versus profile accolade/fate and separate end-chat unlock have different consumers. T5material generation tier/eligible modifier/sequential roll/equipped actual means/Blockconsumer, temporary grant and removal remain distinct; numeric chance code is not a tested distribution or deterministic replay contract. These semantics are read in the existing report/packets, not freshly reverified in external Lua/C.

F4: Preserve the three original proposals: materially different harness fits reaching actual guard/pull costs, finite maintained brace with explicit payment/capacity/release/cleanup, and earned specific lesson versus an actually stocked sleeve. They are alternatives/extensions of existing YAIR owners, not copied ToMEcontent, mandatory new talent/sustain/AI/equipment frameworks or new source worlds. Actual equipped custody, body/source/support, teacher willingness/stock, earned deed and one delivered branch must stay separate. Historical fixed-key consumers/file offsets are not current absence or a new integration grant; reread applicable current producers/state/consumers when a slice is selected.

F5: The packet header’s historical blanket behavior-suite deferral is corrected: current AD36/AD43define applicable focused/completion evidence, and AD42makes human taste review optional. No current source feature is implemented or gateclosed here. Older one-prestige saved meaning is compatibility context rather than a restored project milestone. Exact synthetic source/readback proof, actual runtime/build, native journey/persistence/profile durability, current ownership and human selection remain separate. No new acquisition, source tree mutation/read of excluded code, game launch, runtime implementation/test/build/browser/save/profile access, worker, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.

F1: Full actual content review covers713-line COVERAGE.json, every root field, all five GAME1–5requested original gameplay rows with zero original source paths, nine framework/mod paths, all34qualified source-span records with complete pins/URLs/hashes/ranges/RL-MODIDs/read-review-integration qualifiers, five YAIRdirection counts/two readerrecords/private snapshots, four coordinator supplements, three unread/four unperformed groups. Complete compact JSON root and three record groups were actually read, not inferred from filename inventory. Original JSON bytes/schema stay unchanged; overlapping intervals are not independent line-reading events.

F2: Conditional available-source fallback complete is compatible with original-game source coverage0/5; it cannot be renamed full game completion. RogueLibs/framework wrappers and actual Wizard mod bodies are third-party code, while original relationship/hostility/ownership, objective settlement, base trait/ability/status actions, material propagation, procedural generation and original unlock debit remain external. Local assembly/decompile unavailability is a dated intake result, not a fresh whole-machine/public-search conclusion or permanent impossibility. No new source access/acquisition/decompile occurs; these explicit gaps do not block completing this document review.

F3: RL01captured options/deferred menu side effects do not prove pure previews or NPC internals. RL02tool/menu reach,time/noise arguments do not show external wear/reaction/quest mutation. RL03use/combine/target/filter/redirect gates do not prove action-callback revalidation or rollback. RL04device reach and technology eligibility do not implement propagation/damage/evacuation/debit. RL05press/hold/release/recharge interface is not decrement/exception-cleanup proof. RL06attach/update/refresh/disposal is not vanilla duration/cleanup guarantee. RL07forced-free unlock and backup restoration are distinct from paid debit/atomic profile save. MOD01prepaidcooldown remains spent on fizzle/caught exception; random choice is not a durable plan. MOD02hit attribution/consumed tag/neutralization completion/payoff and memory-only partial kills have separate lifecycle/failure states. These are bounded findings reused from actual owner report, not freshly read original game code.

F4: Existing five-direction YAIRnotes identify authored shelf alternatives, conserved material/tool chains, source/body/condition-aware fixed NPC choices, local environmental residue and explicit finite conduct/preparation records. Missing consumer none found is relative to that dated read; it does not prove generalized AI, whole city physics, all unlocks or every current path. Later source implementation must inspect its current owner before declaring a new missing subsystem. Zero new packets is a substantive duplicate-disposition, not absent analysis. Keep existing journals/custody/quote/action/durable publisher/history and all actual prerequisites/payments/aftermath; do not mint duplicate stock/schema/progression to compensate for missing source.

F5: Preserve pure source/read/review/integration counters separately from rebuilt natural routes, save/reload/import/failure/keyboard/regression and optional human review under AD42. Private observed copies/hashes document the historical input; read-only chmod is not ongoing freshness or current branch proof. Future proof scenarios in the five existing journeys are specified-not-run, and old source availability/current owner statements are now dated at the report opening. The fallback authorizes no new gameplay/decompile/installation/purchase or user-save access. No runtime/code change, source acquisition, worker, test/build/browser/game launch, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.
